questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the angles formed when two lines intersect?
questions.solution: When two lines intersect, they form four angles. Vertically opposite angles are always equal. Linear pairs add up to 180°, but they are not equal. Not all angles are equal unless the lines are perpendicular. Not all angles are right angles unless the lines are perpendicular.

hi.stem: जब दो रेखाएं प्रतिच्छेद करती हैं, तो बने कोणों के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सही है?
hi.solution: जब दो रेखाएं प्रतिच्छेद करती हैं, तो चार कोण बनते हैं। लम्बाक्ष युग्म हमेशा बराबर होते हैं। रैखिक युग्म 180° के बराबर होते हैं, लेकिन वे बराबर नहीं होते। सभी कोण बराबर तभी होते हैं जब रेखाएं लंबवत होती हैं। सभी कोण समकोण तभी होते हैं जब रेखाएं लंबवत होती हैं।
hi.critique: The translation accurately preserves the meaning, technical terms, and logical structure of the original question.

mr.stem: जेव्हा दोन रेषा छेदतात तेव्हा तयार होणाऱ्या कोनांबद्दल खालीलपैकी कोणते खरे आहे?
mr.solution: जेव्हा दोन रेषा छेदतात तेव्हा त्यांनी चार कोन तयार केले जातात. लंबकोन नेहमी एकसारखे असतात. रेषीय जोड्या 180° च्या बरोबर असतात, पण ते एकसारखे नसतात. सर्व कोन एकसारखे असतात केव्हा रेषा लंब असतात. सर्व कोन समकोन असतात केव्हा रेषा लंब असतात.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms like 'लंबकोन' (vertically opposite angles) and 'रेषीय जोड्या' (linear pairs) as used in Marathi textbooks.

questions.stem: When two lines intersect and form four equal angles, what are they called?
questions.solution: When two lines intersect and form four equal angles, each angle must be 90°, which defines perpendicular lines. Perpendicular lines are characterized by forming right angles at their intersection. The other options do not describe lines that form equal angles of 90°.

hi.stem: जब दो रेखाएं एक दूसरे को काटती हैं और चार समान कोण बनाती हैं, तो उन्हें क्या कहा जाता है?
hi.solution: जब दो रेखाएं एक दूसरे को काटती हैं और चार समान कोण बनाती हैं, तो प्रत्येक कोण 90° होना चाहिए, जो लंबवत रेखाओं की परिभाषा है। लंबवत रेखाएं अपने प्रतिच्छेदन पर समकोण बनाने के लिए विशेषता रखती हैं। अन्य विकल्प उन रेखाओं का वर्णन नहीं करते जो 90° के समान कोण बनाती हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English question and solution, with appropriate terminology used in Hindi geometry textbooks.

mr.stem: जेव्हा दोन रेषा एकमेकांना छेदतात आणि चार समान कोन तयार करतात, त्यांना काय म्हणतात?
mr.solution: जेव्हा दोन रेषा एकमेकांना छेदतात आणि चार समान कोन तयार करतात, तेव्हा प्रत्येक कोन 90° असतो, जे लंब रेषांचे वैशिष्ट्य आहे. लंब रेषा त्यांच्या छेदनबिंदूवर लंब कोन तयार करतात. इतर पर्याय असे रेषा वर्णन करत नाहीत ज्या 90° चे समान कोन तयार करतात.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Marathi technical terms used.

questions.stem: What is the term for two lines that never meet on a plane?
questions.solution: Parallel lines are defined as two lines that never meet on a plane, no matter how far they are extended. Perpendicular lines intersect at a right angle, intersecting lines cross at some point, and transversal refers to a line that intersects two or more other lines.

hi.stem: एक तल पर दो ऐसी रेखाओं के लिए क्या शब्द है जो कभी मिलती नहीं?
hi.solution: समांतर रेखाएं एक तल पर दो ऐसी रेखाएं होती हैं जो कभी मिलती नहीं हैं, चाहे उन्हें कितना भी बढ़ाया जाए। लंबवत रेखाएं समकोण पर मिलती हैं, छेदक रेखाएं किसी बिंदु पर मिलती हैं और अनुप्रस्थ एक ऐसी रेखा होती है जो दो या अधिक अन्य रेखाओं को काटती है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the original English question and solution, with appropriate technical terms used in Hindi.

questions.stem: If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle, intersecting the other two sides, what can be said about the two sides?
choices: They are perpendicular to each other
They are divided in the same ratio
They are divided in different ratios
questions.solution: When a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle and intersects the other two sides, it divides those sides proportionally. This is a fundamental geometric principle that ensures the segments on each side are in the same ratio. The other options are incorrect because there is no basis for them in the properties of parallel lines and triangles.

hi.stem: यदि एक त्रिभुज के एक भुजा के समांतर एक रेखा खींची जाती है, जो अन्य दो भुजाओं को काटती है, तो दोनों भुजाओं के बारे में क्या कहा जा सकता है?

questions.stem: In Fig. 5.35, if lines LM and PQ are parallel, and a transversal intersects them, what is the measure of angle ∠NOP?
questions.solution: When a transversal intersects two parallel lines, alternate interior angles are equal. If one of these angles is given as 52°, then the angle ∠NOP, which is an alternate interior angle, must also be 52°. The other options do not correspond to the correct angle relationship formed by the transversal and the parallel lines.

questions.stem: In a scenario where two lines are parallel and a transversal cuts them, if one of the corresponding angles is 70°, what is the measure of the other corresponding angle?

questions.stem: Two lines on a plane do not meet even when extended. What can be concluded about these lines?
questions.solution: Parallel lines are defined as lines that lie on the same plane and never meet, even when extended. Since the lines in question do not meet, they must be parallel. Perpendicular lines intersect at a right angle, intersecting lines meet at a point, and skew lines are not on the same plane, which is not the case here.

questions.stem: In a diagram, two lines are intersected by a transversal, and one pair of corresponding angles is found to be equal. What can be concluded about the two lines?
questions.solution: If a transversal intersects two lines and a pair of corresponding angles are equal, the lines must be parallel because corresponding angles are congruent only when the lines are parallel. Perpendicular lines form right angles, which is not indicated here. Intersecting lines would not have equal corresponding angles unless they are parallel. Therefore, the correct answer is 'They are parallel'.
